svg.text: When I ask the AI, in this document:
New: "Move to Slide" in a chart's object menu.
It makes a slide named after the chart, right after
this sheet, and moves the chart object onto it: one
step, undone as one. The chart fills the frame first.
The chart stays the same chart (its data, kind and
titles); nothing is left behind on the sheet.
No key yet: menus are reworked later. The other entries
are a chart's today (Snap to grid is creates' only).
